tex_content.label: pinchd
tex_content.html:
A generalized Ricci flow on $[0,\infty )$ is curvature pinched toward positive when, for every $x$,

  1. $R(x)\ge -6/(4{\bf t}(x)+1)$;

  2. $R(x)\ge 2X(x)(\log X(x)+\log (1+{\bf t}(x))-3)$ whenever $X(x)>0$,

where $X$ is the maximum of zero and the negative smallest eigenvalue of $\Rm $.
